Merhaba, Ben Uzman Psikolog & Aile Danış: Hello, I am Expert Psychologist & Family Counselor Fatma İzel ŞAHİN KAYA. I graduated from Istanbul 29 Mayıs University, Department of Psychology as a high honor student. During my undergraduate studies, I observed and did internships in kindergartens, high schools and various associations. I completed my master's degree with thesis on Developmental Psychology at Maltepe University. I received training and gained experience in objective and projective tests used in the evaluation process of children. In therapy, I apply Cognitive Behavioral Play Therapy, Enneagram, Fairy Tale Therapy, Children's Drawing Analysis, Solution Focused Therapy, Schema Therapy and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, for which I have received training, as required. I provide online counseling and face-to-face therapy services in family and couple counseling, individual therapy, child and adolescent therapy. I evaluate each individual individually and am pleased to accompany people in their self-awareness, change and development processes. See you soon, too.
Terapi süresi ortalama 45 dakikadır. Bu: Therapy duration is approximately 45 minutes. This process includes the progress of the client and the counselor together, and the change and development process of the client. Health is not a state of physical well-being alone, but a state of spiritual well-being and should be considered as a whole. The first session therapy agenda is determined by taking a detailed history of the client. The progress of the subsequent sessions proceeds in line with the explanation of the school to be applied and the use of various techniques according to necessity. Since each individual is unique, the session structure and duration vary depending on the client.

Bilişsel Davranışçı Terapi (BDT), bireyl:
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is a modern psychotherapy approach that addresses the relationship between individuals' emotions, thoughts and behaviors, and whose effectiveness has been proven by scientific research. This therapy method is based on the fact that the difficulties people experience may arise not only from events, but also from the meaning and thought patterns they attribute to these events. 
During the therapy process, thought and behavior patterns that negatively affect the client's daily life are evaluated together; It is aimed to develop healthier, functional and realistic perspectives. Thus, clients' emotional resilience increases, their problem-solving skills are strengthened, and a sustainable improvement in their quality of life is achieved. 
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy; It is effectively applied in many areas such as anxiety, depression, stress management, panic attacks, self-confidence problems and relationship problems. Thanks to its structured and goal-oriented structure, clients are supported to take an active role in the therapy process and the aim is to transfer the gains to daily life. 
Our goal is to help our clients understand the difficulties they experience, enable them to discover their strengths, and provide scientifically based support so they can live a more balanced life.
